## Checklist
- [ ] Branch follows `feat/<member>-<feature>` or `fix/<bug>` and targets `develop`
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`)
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally and CI is green
- [ ] New code has docstrings; no secrets, API keys or personal data committed
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] Data use complies with the arXiv API Terms of Use (≥ 3 s between requests)
- [ ] PR has a label and at least one reviewer (Đông for tests/quality, Bảo Phú for architecture)
